questions.prompt: Why did Zippy end up far from Sunny Hollow?
choices: Sunny showed him a hidden path.
He ran past Sunny Hollow and did not stop.
He followed flowers into the valley.
questions.answer: He ran past Sunny Hollow and did not stop.
questions.evidenceText: Zippy ran past the picnic, the waterfall, and Sunny Hollow. He did not stop.

questions.prompt: What did Zippy do beside the flowers?
choices: He ran around the flowers without stopping.
He covered the flowers with a pile of leaves.
He sat beside the flowers and took a slow breath.
questions.answer: He sat beside the flowers and took a slow breath.
questions.evidenceText: He sat beside the flowers and took a slow breath.

questions.prompt: What could Zippy see because he went slowly on the way home?
choices: a race flag and finish line
a dark cave and hidden map
questions.evidenceText: Zippy walked home with Sunny. He went slowly enough to see the trees, clouds, and path.
